comparison.objective: Place and orient two weld-neck flanges on riser stubs to plant centerlines, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy circular-part placement, bore/stub alignment, and two-hole rotational orientation versus recessed-tool insertion, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and response-guided locking.
comparison.success_condition: Both flanges seated and two-holed to specified centerlines versus two safe repeatable impacts within quantified limits.
comparison.reason: Precision flange fit-up is distinct from adjustable energy-absorber commissioning. No specs provide angular, positional, or seating tolerances.
